tools.name: evm_block
tools.description: Block number on Base: the latest block height, timestamp, age, base fee, gas used and transaction count. Use it when an agent needs the current block number or the chain head. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_gas
tools.description: Gas price on Base in gwei, split into base fee and priority fee, with the block it was read at. Use it to estimate gas fees before sending a transaction. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_balance
tools.description: Wallet balance on Base: the native ETH balance for any address, in wei and ETH, with the block height it was read at. Use it to read a wallet balance. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_token_balance
tools.description: Token balance on Base: the ERC20 balance of an address, with raw units, decimals and the token symbol resolved on-chain. Use it to read a token balance. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_nonce
tools.description: Wallet nonce on Base: the next transaction nonce for any address. Use it to build a transaction without racing the mempool. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_tx
tools.description: Transaction lookup on Base by hash: decoded from, to, value, nonce, gas and max fee, and whether it is mined or pending. Use it to inspect any transaction. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_receipt
tools.description: Transaction receipt on Base: success or reverted, block, gas used, effective gas price, log count and created contract. Use it to confirm a transaction or read its status. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_transfers
tools.description: ERC20 transfers on Base for an address over the last N blocks (default 5000), newest first, with tx hashes. Use it to list incoming token transfers. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Crypto price and token price in USD with 24h change and market cap for one or more CoinGecko ids (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, ...). Use it when an agent needs a current price before quoting or sizing a trade. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: dex_quote
tools.description: DEX quote and liquidity: live pair quotes for a token or pair query, with price in USD, liquidity and 24h volume across chains. Use it to compare venues before a swap. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_tx_status
tools.description: Transaction status on Base: success, reverted or pending for a given transaction hash, with block number, confirmations and gas used. Use it to check whether a transfer confirmed. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_token_info
tools.description: Token metadata for an ERC20 contract on Base: name, symbol, decimals and total supply. Use it before formatting any token amount or price. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_contract
tools.description: Contract check and ABI for an address on Base: whether it is a contract, its bytecode size, whether Sourcify verified it, and the ABI when available. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio for a wallet on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum in one call: native balance, nonce and the balance of up to ten ERC20 tokens with symbol and decimals. Use it when an agent needs a full wallet snapshot instead of many calls. Price: 0.005 USDC per call over x402 on Base.

tools.name: evm_decode
tools.description: Decode an EVM transaction: given a transaction hash, or raw calldata plus a contract address, return the function selector, every known signature for it and the decoded static arguments. Use it to explain what a transaction does before signing or reporting it. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on
